purpose: E177 audited the best-W方案 (E170 three-way score fusion) and found gates #2/#3/#4 pass while #9/#10 fail, with #1/#5/#6/#7/#8 left unmeasured (E177 wrongly reported #5/#6 from a coarse curve). E178 measures exactly those five gates on the same frozen score: #1 in-sample Train accuracy, #5 pseudo-unknown AUROC under the verbatim LOSO protocol, #6 U@95/90/98, and #7/#8 RA/ASafeR against a self-built end-to-end differentiable PGD surrogate. No existing experiment directory is modified; Test is only scored with frozen quantities and its official metrics stay N/A.

audited_scheme.name: E170 three-way score fusion, best-W point

fusion.stream_zscore: each stream score z-scored with its own 5-block Train OOF mean/std, exactly as E170

features.logbp_bands_note: E146 uses its own 5 bands (delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma), different from the E36/E65 logSPD bands; the cached train_log_band_power.npy equals E146 train_phase[:, :90] exactly

protocol.loso_prototype_rows: pm & fit_rows (19 enrolled identities, frac <= 0.6 only)
protocol.loso_known: window rows of the 19 enrolled identities
protocol.loso_unknown: window rows of the held-out identity
protocol.train_only: task-wise standardisation, PCA basis and prototypes are Train-only; no Session field is read for any model/threshold/feature decision

gates.gate1_insample: prototypes from all 11304 Train rows, predict the same rows
gates.gate5_auroc: pooled 20-fold known-vs-unknown; AUROC reported with unknown as the positive class (equivalent to E170 loso_auc since the score is a similarity)
gates.gate6_u: per fold threshold = per-fold known quantile at the stated known acceptance; U = fraction of unknown below it; mean over 20 folds

gate7_8_proxy.domain: Train eval window 0.6 < frac <= 0.8 (identity labels available); stratified sample, cap 400 per task
gate7_8_proxy.why_train: Test has no identity labels, so RA/ASafeR cannot be computed there; Test session labels are never used here
gate7_8_proxy.eps_definition: L-infinity bound = eps * per-trial global RMS (the same RMS used by the E162 normalisation); signal RMS = 1, so eps = 0.01 is >= 40 dB SNR
gate7_8_proxy.goal_A: maximise the fused score of the best wrong identity (targeted impersonation)
gate7_8_proxy.goal_B: maximise logsumexp over identities (evade the reject class)
gate7_8_proxy.goal_C: maximise z(target) - z(true), i.e. a margin/decision-boundary impersonation attack; added because goal A alone mostly produces a common-mode score shift that leaves the argmax intact, so it would give an optimistic RA
gate7_8_proxy.primary_gate_reading: gate #7 uses the lowest RA and gate #8 the lowest ASafeR over all goals and eps

reporting.test_official: N/A: the Test split has no public identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: none: this experiment reads no Test file and no Session column
reporting.attack_status: self-built white-box PGD surrogate, not the official attack suite; gates #7/#8 values are reference/upper-bound evidence only
